purpose: Normal input spoken like a real call: the five required cases and an open question, as in T1, plus a hedged offer, small talk, fillers, laughter and two interruptions. Written before its first run.
traps: Dark mode must not become an agreed task: Tom only offered it ("we could") and Sofia turned it down while he was still talking.
The room booking must end cancelled (L34), although Sofia first said "I'll book it anyway" (L21).
The privacy policy update must not get an owner: nobody took it.
The flaky tests are hedged ("I'll try… no promises"): Sofia's "That's fine" does not turn them into a commitment.
The staging demo deadline must be Monday, not Thursday; the migration question in between (L30–L31) is not a task.
The auth and webhook details belong to the API docs task, not a separate one.
Small talk (the weekend, moving apartments) and the projector jokes are not items.
The interruptions at L15 and L20 start while the other person is still talking; quotes must stay with the person who said them.
No calendar dates anywhere: the call never says what day it is.
